'''Tindercub''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Specialist]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Kitjitsu]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "It's impossible for Tindercub to sit still during meditation. Why do something so boring, when there are roses and butterflies out there?"

Tindercub is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Tindercub's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Kitjitsu]] you need to complete the following task:
* Use Tindercub to clear 20 stages.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Master's first lesson: meditate for 3 hours on a catnip log. For Tindercub, this is the ultimate test of focus..."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Tindercub began practicing pouncing even before the stripes were fully grown, but landed more often on the ground instead of the target. Also practices mediation daily but can never last a full minute."
